```{r}
long_data <- readRDS(here("Woods_Creek_data","long_data_clean.Rds"))
data_clean <- readRDS(here("Woods_Creek_data","data_clean_noNA.Rds"))
```



```{r}
#descriptive treatment variable
long_data$TRT<-long_data$TMT
levels(long_data$TRT)<-c("Unthinned","Light Thin","Thin")

#generate data subset for ANOVA
AOV_in<-subset(long_data, long_data$YEAR_F==2020)
#AOV_in<-subset(stand_level_df, stand_level_df$YEAR_F==2020 & is.na(stand_level_df$COND_CUM)==FALSE)

#sum all species

AOV_in_spec_comb<-AOV_in 
#stand_level_df<- plot_level_df %>% group_by(Stand_ID_TB, YEAR_F, species_gen, COND_CUM, .drop = FALSE)%>% summarise(count = n(), live_count = sum(count))

#calculate number dead and number alive including ".drop = FALSE"
AOV_alive2<-subset(AOV_in, AOV_in$COND_CUM==1|AOV_in$COND_CUM==2)
AOV_alive2_count<- AOV_alive2 %>% group_by(TMT,BLOCK,PLOT,.drop = FALSE)%>%summarise(Live_count=n(), live_BA=sum(live_BA,na.rm=TRUE))

AOV_dead<-subset(AOV_in, AOV_in$COND_CUM==0|AOV_in$COND_CUM==3|AOV_in$COND_CUM==4)
AOV_dead_count<- AOV_dead %>% group_by(TMT,BLOCK,PLOT,.drop = FALSE)%>%summarise(Dead_count=n())  

AOV_prop_dead<-cbind(AOV_alive2_count, AOV_dead_count["Dead_count"])
AOV_prop_dead$total<-(AOV_prop_dead$Live_count+AOV_prop_dead$Dead_count)
AOV_prop_dead$prop_dead<-(AOV_prop_dead$Dead_count/AOV_prop_dead$total)

#remove plots with both 0 alive and 0 dead
AOV_prop_dead<-subset(AOV_prop_dead, AOV_prop_dead$total !=0)

#arcsine transforrmation of proportion dead
AOV_prop_dead$asn<-asin(sqrt(AOV_prop_dead$prop_dead))
#adding combined treatment varialbe to comgine thinning treatments
AOV_prop_dead$TMT2<-as.factor(ifelse(AOV_prop_dead$TMT=="1","1","2"))
glimpse(AOV_prop_dead)

#convert from plot-level to stand-level summaries
AOV_prop_dead_stand<- AOV_prop_dead %>% group_by(TMT,BLOCK,.drop = FALSE)%>%summarise(Live_count=sum(Live_count),live_BA=sum(live_BA), Dead_count=sum(Dead_count), total=sum(total),TMT2=first(TMT2))

#recalculate prop dead and arcsin prop dead
AOV_prop_dead_stand$prop_dead<-(AOV_prop_dead_stand$Dead_count/AOV_prop_dead_stand$total)
AOV_prop_dead_stand$asn_prop_dead<-asin(sqrt(AOV_prop_dead_stand$prop_dead))

#adding initial and final proportions of plots with LRR detected
AOV_prop_dead_stand$init_LRR<-as.double(c(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.6,0.8,1.0,0.4,1.0,0.4,0.6,0.4,0.4,0.8,0.6,0.4))
AOV_prop_dead_stand$fin_LRR<-as.double(c(0.8,0.8,0.8,0.6,1.0,1.0,0.4,1.0,0.4,0.4,0.4,0.4,0.2,0.4,0.6))

write_rds(AOV_prop_dead_stand,here("Woods_Creek_data","WC_anova_inputs.Rds"))


```

```{r}
#Linear model, assumption testing and ANOVA
#example provided by stats consult https://rpubs.com/tmcurley/twowayanova

#len.aov <- aov(len ~ supp + dose + supp:dose, data = ToothGrowth)
#summary(len.aov)

#assumption testing via:
#https://arc.lib.montana.edu/book/statistics-with-r-textbook/item/57

#Proportion dead
mort.aov <- lm(prop_dead ~ TMT+BLOCK, data= AOV_prop_dead_stand)
summary(mort.aov)
anova(mort.aov)

#diagnostic plots
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(mort.aov)
eij=residuals(mort.aov)
hist(eij,main="Histogram of residuals")
plot(density(eij),main="Density plot of residuals",ylab="Density",xlab="Residuals")

#arcin transformed Proportion dead
asn_mort.aov <- lm(asn_prop_dead ~ TMT+BLOCK, data= AOV_prop_dead_stand)
summary(asn_mort.aov)
anova(asn_mort.aov)


#diagnostic plots
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(asn_mort.aov)
eij=residuals(asn_mort.aov)
hist(eij,main="Histogram of residuals")
plot(density(eij),main="Density plot of residuals",ylab="Density",xlab="Residuals")


#including initial incidence
asn_mort_incidence.aov <- lm(asn_prop_dead ~ TMT+BLOCK+init_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead_stand)
summary(asn_mort_incidence.aov)
anova(asn_mort_incidence.aov)

#including initial incidence and interaction
asn_mort_incidence_interact.aov <- lm(asn_prop_dead ~ BLOCK+TMT*init_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead_stand)
summary(asn_mort_incidence_interact.aov)
anova(asn_mort_incidence_interact.aov)

#comparing model with and without LRR_init
anova(asn_mort_incidence.aov, asn_mort.aov)
anova(asn_mort_incidence_interact.aov, asn_mort.aov)

##combining thinning treatments

#arcin transformed Proportion dead
asn_mort_TMT2.aov <- lm(asn_prop_dead ~ TMT2+BLOCK, data= AOV_prop_dead_stand)
summary(asn_mort_TMT2.aov)
anova(asn_mort_TMT2.aov)


#diagnostic plots
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
plot(asn_mort_TMT2.aov)
eij=residuals(asn_mort_TMT2.aov)
hist(eij,main="Histogram of residuals")
plot(density(eij),main="Density plot of residuals",ylab="Density",xlab="Residuals")
```
```{r}
#Live basal area
BA.aov <- aov(live_BA ~ TMT, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(BA.aov)
#TukeyHSD(len.aov, which = "dose")
TukeyHSD(BA.aov, which = "TMT")
plot(BA.aov,1)
plot(BA.aov,2)

plot(AOV_prop_dead$TMT,AOV_prop_dead$live_BA)

##combining thinning treatments

BA.aov2 <- aov(asn ~ TMT2, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(BA.aov2)
plot(BA.aov2,1)
plot(BA.aov2,2)

plot(AOV_prop_dead$TMT2,AOV_prop_dead$live_BA)
```



```{r}
#ANCOVA using final proportion of plots with LRR detected as a covariate
mort.aocv <- aov(asn ~ TMT+fin_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(mort.aocv)
#TukeyHSD(len.aov, which = "dose")
TukeyHSD(mort.aocv, which = "TMT")
plot(mort.aocv,1)
plot(mort.aocv,2)
plot(AOV_prop_dead$fin_LRR,AOV_prop_dead$prop_dead)

mort.aocv2 <- aov(asn ~ TMT2+fin_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(mort.aocv2)
plot(mort.aocv2,1)
plot(mort.aocv2,2)
```

```{r}
#ANCOVA using initial proportion of plots with LRR detected as a covariate
mort.aocv <- aov(asn ~ TMT+init_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(mort.aocv)
#TukeyHSD(len.aov, which = "dose")
TukeyHSD(mort.aocv, which = "TMT")
plot(mort.aocv,1)
plot(mort.aocv,2)
plot(AOV_prop_dead$fin_LRR,AOV_prop_dead$prop_dead)

mort.aocv2 <- aov(asn ~ TMT2+init_LRR, data= AOV_prop_dead)
summary(mort.aocv2)
plot(mort.aocv2,1)
plot(mort.aocv2,2)
```
## Methods
### Plot establishment and measurement
Replication (5 stands), five 1/10 acre circular plots within each stand were established and measured at teach timepoint for a total of 1/2 acre surveyed within each plot. intial incidence, thinning treatments definition and timing, forest type/species composition, location, condition codes. Trees recruited into the plots following initial thinning treatment we're only analyzed if they were larger than 15.25 cm DBH.

### Forest Vegetation Simulator
Used proportion of plots within a stand in which LRR was detected as area of root disease parameter. Version of program. Any non-default parameters including interations.  

### Statistical analysis
Basal area?
Proportion mortality

## Results/Discussion

No significant effects were found in any of the statistical models for proportion of mortality (arcsine transformed).
